exposure: Pregnancies with prior SFLP vs. no prior SFLP
Selective fetoscopic laser photocoagulation (SFLP) for twin-twin transfusion syndrome (TTTS)
cohort: Patients evaluated at the Cincinnati Fetal Center (2007-2014) for monochorionic multiple gestations.
finding: SFLP was not associated with adverse reproductive, obstetric, or gynecologic outcomes.
